Path Traversal: Sanitize videoFileName # We ignore the user-provided path and only take the basename to prevent traversal safe_filename = os.path.basename(videoFileName) if not safe_filename: safe_filename = "input_video.tmp" input_path = os.path.join(tmpdir, safe_filename) output_path = os.path.join(tmpdir, "frame.png") # 3.
